title: Greek salad with chicken
ingredients: 1 1/2 lb boneless chicken breasts or thighs, cut into chunks
steps: Toss chicken with 1 tbsp oil, oregano, half the lemon, garlic, salt, and pepper. Rest 15 minutes.
Sear chicken in a hot skillet until browned and cooked through, 6–8 minutes. Cool slightly.
Toss romaine, tomatoes, cucumber, olives, chickpeas, and feta with remaining oil and lemon.
Top with chicken and more black pepper.
